Predicts Takeover Request?: No (False — Evaluated Counterfactually)
1. Genuine VLA Trajectory Source (Phase B) All 7 trajectories are decoded from real AutoVLA forward passes on 12-frame multi-view camera history and ego kinematics. AutoVLA does not output a takeover request signal.
2. Independent Trajectory Verifier (Phase C) Evaluates continuity, speed, acceleration, braking, yaw rate, Kamm friction circle, and initial-state acceleration consistency (C1–C10) on the 0.5 s grid. Passing checks does not establish safety.
3. Counterfactual R3B Fallback (Phase D/E) Connects ego states to frozen R3B braking-only bounds across transition policies P0 (hold speed), P1 (passive drag), and P2 (supported decel 1–3 m/s²). Any state with an assumed obstacle distance d0 or τreq > 0 is explicitly badged as counterfactual/hypothetical.
4. Explicit Insufficient-Evidence Boundaries TTC is never inferred from images alone. Open-road scenes without an assumed d0, stationary ego scenes (v0 ≤ 0.05 m/s), and turning trajectories leaving the ±1.75 m corridor return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_OR_NOT_APPLICABLE.
Executive Research Summary

Key Empirical Findings Across the 7 Real nuPlan / NAVSIM Driving Scenes (Click Any Finding to Inspect)

7 Genuine VLA Predictions • 1,011 Parameter-Sweep Rows (Counterfactual Grid, Not 1,011 Independent Scenes)
Finding 1 — High-Speed & Arterial Accuracy EXT-VLA-C01

In steady forward cruising (Scene 01, v0 = 13.58 m/s; Scene 04, v0 = 6.21 m/s) and intersection turns (Scene 06, v0 = 8.78 m/s), AutoVLA satisfies all C1–C10 checks with ADE = 0.36–0.66 m and FDE = 0.76–2.09 m.

Finding 2 — Active-Braking Prompt Norm Limitation EXT-VLA-C03

In Scene 05 (observed ax,0 = −1.5525 m/s²), AutoVLA's prompt passes unsigned norm 1.56 m/s². After Step 1 (−0.88 m/s²), the plan reverses to +1.5442 m/s² at Step 3, violating C10 (|alon,3 − ax,0| = 3.10 m/s² > 2.50 m/s², FDE = 12.90 m).

Finding 3 — Wet-Road Lateral & Timing Erosion EXT-VLA-C04

In Scene 02 (v0 = 6.95 m/s, observed stationary obstacle d0 = 55.49 m), wet-road urban turning bound is violated (|alat| = 2.27 m/s² > 2.0 m/s²). Across scenes, delaying τreq erodes R3B margins from positive to violated (P0 fails earliest; P2 preserves margin longest).

Finding 4 — Explicit Evidence Boundaries EXT-VLA-C05

R3B evaluation is withheld in open-road observed mode (Scene 01, 05, 06), stationary ego baseline (Scene 07, v0 = 0.0019 m/s), and turning states exiting the ±1.75 m / ±0.35 rad 1D corridor (Scene 02 τreq ≥ 1.5 s, Scene 06 τreq ≥ 2.0 s).

Methodological Limitation — Driving-Command Conditioning & Future-Displacement Leakage Risk (EXT-VLA-C06): In Scene 02 (scene_02_stationary_lead_obstacle, yGT(3.0 s) = +4.51 m, yGT(5.0 s) = +16.67 m) and Scene 06 (scene_06_intersection_turn_maneuver, yGT(3.0 s) = +4.09 m, yGT(5.0 s) = +8.35 m), the effective "turn left" prompt command corresponds to future ground-truth lateral displacement rather than an independent pre-trip navigation signal (and when an unknown raw command is resolved from future lateral displacement, this constitutes future-information leakage). Recorded inference inputs are preserved unmodified for provenance integrity, and affected ADE/FDE metrics are bounded as command-conditioned evaluations rather than strictly leakage-free blind predictions.

            Priority 3 Deep-Dive — Scene 05 Active-Braking Finding & Controlled Signed-Acceleration Prompt Ablation
          
          

            Distinguishing Input-Representation Limitation (‖a(0)‖ = 1.56 m/s²) from Causal Attribution (ax(0) = −1.5525 m/s²)
          

        

        
      

      

        

          

            

              
1. Logged Ground Truth

              
Brakes 4.31 → 2.29 m/s (t ≤ 2.5 s)

              

                Observed ax(0) = −1.5525 m/s², ay(0) = +0.1831 m/s². Decelerates to x = 6.92 m at t = 2.5 s, then gently accelerates to x = 15.65 m at t = 5.0 s.
              

            

            

              
2. Standard AutoVLA (Unsigned Norm)

              
Prompt: "1.56 m/s^2" (‖a‖ = 1.5633)

              

                Step 1 decelerates (alon,1 = −0.8841 m/s²), then reverses at Step 2 (+0.7917 m/s²) and peaks at Step 3 (+1.5442 m/s²), reaching x10 = 28.53 m (ADE = 6.25 m, FDE = 12.90 m).
              

            

            

              
3. Controlled OOD Signed Ablation

              
Prompt: "-1.55 m/s^2" (Signed ax,0)

              

                Identical images & v0: sustains braking across Steps 1–7 (alon ∈ [−1.39, −0.88] m/s²) to standstill at x10 = 6.93 m (0–2 s braking ADE = 0.14 m; 5 s ADE = 2.42 m).
              

            

          

          

            Mandatory Scientific Boundary on Causal Attribution:
            (1) Passing a negative acceleration string (-1.55 m/s^2) is an out-of-distribution (OOD) prompt intervention relative to AutoVLA's training interface (np.linalg.norm(acceleration) ≥ 0) and is not a validated model upgrade.
            (2) Even under the standard unsigned prompt (1.56 m/s^2), Step 1 still decelerates at −0.8841 m/s² from multi-frame visual cues before the trajectory reverses at Steps 2–3.
            (3) Under the OOD signed prompt, once the vehicle reaches standstill at t = 3.5 s (x = 6.98 m), Step 9 emits a 5.8 cm backward jitter token (<action_126>). Thus, unsigned acceleration encoding is a verified input-representation limitation and strong contributing factor in Scene 05, not a single-cause deterministic law.

        Critical Interpretation Rule (Command-Conditioned ADE/FDE vs. Logged Human Turn):
        In Scene 02 (yGT(5.0 s) = +16.67 m) and Scene 06 (yGT(5.0 s) = +8.35 m), the logged human ground-truth trajectory executes a left-turn maneuver. It is not a valid ground-truth reference target for a deliberately different "keep forward" intervention command. Reported ADE/FDE differences under "keep forward" quantify command sensitivity relative to the recorded turning trajectory, not policy quality, driving safety, or superiority/inferiority of either trajectory. Outside the ±1.75 m / ±0.35 rad longitudinal corridor (or without an observed 3D in-lane obstacle), R3B braking-only recoverability explicitly returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_OR_NOT_APPLICABLE.

D4 Physical & Numerical Sanity Checks: Observed ax(0) = −1.5525 m/s² (v0 = 4.3103 m/s). Under canonical unsigned prompt (1.56 m/s^2), Step 1 decelerates (−0.8841 m/s² on E1/E3; −1.7658 m/s² on E2), then 9 consecutive steps (t = 1.0..5.0 s) exhibit positive acceleration, reaching x(5.0 s) = 28.534 m vs. logged GT 15.648 m (+12.89 m overshoot). Heading distortion on Steps 2–10 is < 0.0019 m/s² (< 0.07%).

            
D5 Signed-Acceleration OOD Comparison (-1.55 m/s^2): Sustains negative acceleration across all active-motion steps (t = 0.5..3.5 s, max |alon − ax(0)| ≤ 0.6684 m/s², 0/75 active-motion C10 violations; single-scene OOD diagnostic).
